briefdescription.para: The divisor in the previous query. Can be null.

detaileddescription.para: Constructs an object with the given configuration. The configuration is copied into the object, so a reference to the passed-in object is not kept. The configuration is not copied other than the initial copy.
Returns whether there are any entries.
Returns the number of entries.
Returns a string that describes the data structure.
Returns a reference to this object's configuration object.
Returns a reference to this object's configuration object.
Removes all multiples of monomial. A duplicate counts as a multiple. Returns true if any multiples were removed.
Removes all multiples of monomial. A duplicate counts as a multiple. Returns true if any multiples were removed. Calls out.push_back(entry) for each entry that is removed.
Calls out.proceed(entry) for each entry that monomial divides. The method returns if proceed returns false, otherwise the search for divisors proceeds.
Calls out.proceed(entry) for each entry that monomial divides. The method returns if proceed returns false, otherwise the search for divisors proceeds.
Inserts entry into the data structure. Does NOT remove multiples of entry and entry is inserted even if it is a multiple of another entry.
Inserts the entries in the range [begin, end) into the data structure. Does NOT remove multiples of entry and entry is inserted even if it is a multiple of another entry.
The elements in the range [begin, end) may be rearranged by this function, so the range must be mutable. If that is not acceptable, call the one element insert method for each element.
Removes an element whose exponents are equal to monomial's. Returns if there are no such monomials in the data structure.
Returns a pointer to an entry that divides monomial. Returns null if no entries divide monomial.
Returns the position of a divisor of monomial. Returns null if no entries divide monomial.
Calls out.proceed(entry) for each entry that divides monomial. The method returns if proceed returns false, otherwise the search for divisors proceeds.
Calls output.proceed(entry) for each entry that divides monomial. The method returns if proceed returns false, otherwise the search for divisors proceeds.
Calls output.proceed(entry) for each entry. The method returns if proceed returns false, otherwise the search for divisors proceeds.
Calls out.proceed(entry) for each entry. The method returns if proceed returns false, otherwise the search for divisors proceeds.
Removes all entries. Does not reset the configuration object.
Rebuilds the data structure.

Returns the number of bytes allocated by this object. Does not include sizeof(*this), does not include any additional memory that the configuration may have allocated and does not include any memory that an Entry may point to. Does include sizeof(Entry) as well as unused memory that is being kept to avoid frequent allocations.
An object that supports queries for divisors of a monomial using a KD Tree (K Dimensional Tree). See DivFinder.h for more documentation.
Extra fields for Configuration:
bool getSortOnInsert() const Return true to keep the monomials in leaves sorted to speed up queries.
size_t getLeafSize() const Return the fixed maximal size of a leaf.

static const bool AllowRemovals If false, it is an error to call methods that remove elements from the data structure. This can be a slight speed up in some cases. Clear and rebuild is still allowed even if this field is false.
